stem.en: Cold is the nearest word to hot among our 238 words, although the two words mean opposite things. What is the best reason?

text.en: A programmer placed opposite words side by side
One of the numbers in each embedding means temperature
The two words fit the same kinds of sentences
Their token ids are close together in the token list

explanation.en: Training nudges numbers according to how words are used. "Too hot" and "too cold" appear in the same kinds of sentences, so their embeddings become similar. No person places a word, the numbers have no names, and token ids carry no meaning.
